title: Learning from simulated coin flips
description: You can separate the generating probability from the learner's updated parameters.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: TRUE_P_HEADS controls the simulated coin, while alpha and beta start at one. You prepare a table for 70 observations.
Each random draw selects H or T using the generating probability. You increase alpha for H and beta for T.

steps.question: Does mean_belief read TRUE_P_HEADS directly?
steps.answer: No. It uses only the updated alpha and beta through alpha divided by their sum.

steps.description: The supplied excerpt shows a tail after five heads reducing the displayed mean. The final print statements compare inference with the generating value, but their numeric output is beyond this excerpt.
